summary.en: An online editor and solver for Sudoku and a huge range of variant puzzles — a staple in puzzle circles.
summary.zh: 数独与各类变种谜题的在线编辑器 + 求解器，谜题圈口碑工具。

description.en: Draw clues and constraints onto the grid, then let the built-in solver confirm your puzzle has a unique solution. Export the finished puzzle as an image or a shareable link.
description.zh: 在棋盘上绘制线索与约束，内置求解器可判定题目是否有唯一解，可导出题目图与链接分享。

tip.en: Leans tool rather than pure game, but it opens the door to a 'create and solve' corner that keeps hardcore puzzle fans on your site considerably longer.
tip.zh: 偏工具向而非纯游戏，但适合给站点加一个「出题 / 解题」专区，吸引硬核解谜用户停留更久。
